relatives.title: Klute
relatives.shares: a detective's intimacy with someone inside the case becoming the case's real danger

relatives.title: Martha Marcy May Marlene
relatives.shares: a congregation that takes young women in on the promise of belonging and consumes them

relatives.title: Basic Instinct
relatives.shares: sleeping with the person the investigation is closing on

films.title: La Chinoise
films.engine: Five students form a Maoist cell in a luxury apartment lent by one member's rich parents and spend a summer converting reading into doctrine — and the doctrine turns first on them: the one who disagrees is denounced and expelled, the peasant girl does the housework and is kept outside the discussions, and the fragile painter kills himself. The single deed the group produces is an assassination that starts by killing the wrong man in the wrong room.

predicaments.situation: a group founded on a shared belief keeps itself pure by expelling the member who dissents
predicaments.basis: Henri argues the pro-Soviet line against the cell's taste for violence, is labelled a revisionist and thrown out.

predicaments.situation: people who denounce a privileged order conduct the denunciation from inside its comforts, on the labour of the least of them
predicaments.basis: The cell reads Marx in a borrowed rich apartment while Yvonne does the chores, sells sex for money and sits outside the lectures.

predicaments.situation: a member falls apart in plain sight of the group and is only registered once they are dead
predicaments.basis: Kirilov paints rainbows over the slogans on the walls and shoots himself.

predicaments.situation: someone already committed to violence is given the best available argument against it and is not moved
predicaments.basis: Jeanson patiently reasons with Véronique on the train about shutting the universities by force; she goes on to the hotel.

predicaments.situation: an act of political violence falls on the wrong person and is then carried out again on the intended one
predicaments.basis: Véronique reverses the digits of the room number, kills a stranger, and returns to complete the assassination.

predicaments.situation: when the believers disperse, the space is handed back to its owners as if nothing had occurred there
predicaments.basis: The parents return and strip the posters and books from the walls; Guillaume ends up at a fairground stall taking vegetables in the face.

relatives.title: United Red Army
relatives.shares: a revolutionary cell whose discipline turns inward and destroys its own members

relatives.title: The Baader Meinhof Complex
relatives.shares: students who convert study into armed action and find the action arrives badly aimed

relatives.title: Zabriskie Point
relatives.shares: young people whose rejection of the order is staged inside its property

relatives.title: The Wave
relatives.shares: a group whose cohesion depends on identifying and casting out the doubter

relatives.title: Sátántangó
relatives.shares: a community organised by a persuasive doctrine into acts that serve the doctrine and not them

films.title: Something to Talk About
films.engine: A woman sees her husband kiss another woman outside a bank and finds that nobody around her wants the matter raised: he denies what she saw, and her father, whose stable she works in, answers her appeal for support by talking about the competition. Pulling on the marriage pulls up her parents' marriage as well, and behind both is the fact that her own life — the barn, the town, the abandoned degree — was decided for her by a pregnancy she never chose around.

predicaments.situation: a spouse's infidelity is witnessed directly and then denied to the witness's face
predicaments.basis: Grace sees Eddie kiss a blonde outside the bank and catches him at the restaurant; he denies the kiss outright.

predicaments.situation: someone brings a crisis to a parent and is answered with the parent's own preoccupations
predicaments.basis: Grace asks Wyly to stand with her over the marriage; his attention stays entirely on the show jumping and which horse will run.

predicaments.situation: exposing one betrayal detonates the older, buried one in the previous generation
predicaments.basis: Grace's digging turns up her father's many affairs; Georgia throws Wyly out of the house.

predicaments.situation: a person realises the life they are living was settled by an interruption rather than chosen
predicaments.basis: Grace explains she withdrew from the marriage because she had become depressed at having dropped out of veterinary school when she fell pregnant and gone to work for her father instead.

predicaments.situation: the injured party retaliates with something that would be a crime if anyone treated it seriously
predicaments.basis: Grace lightly poisons Eddie with her grandmother's recipe; his response is to quietly see a divorce lawyer.

relatives.title: An Unmarried Woman
relatives.shares: a wife discovering the affair and having to work out what her own life was going to be

relatives.title: Scenes from a Marriage
relatives.shares: a couple forced to state aloud the withdrawals that preceded the betrayal

relatives.title: Diary of a Mad Housewife
relatives.shares: a woman recognising that the life she runs was decided for her

relatives.title: All That Heaven Allows
relatives.shares: a community and family with a stake in a woman not disturbing the arrangement

relatives.title: Tokyo Sonata
relatives.shares: a household in which each member's private collapse is kept from the others until it forces itself out

films.title: No End
films.engine: A month after her husband dies of a heart attack at the wheel, a widow tries every means on offer to be relieved of him — hypnosis, a psychiatrist, a stranger who pays her, his files — and none of them lifts him. Meanwhile the political case he left unfinished passes to an old lawyer who wins it by trading away the client's one uncompromised thing, his hunger strike, for a suspended sentence. Both endings are settlements: the prisoner is released into a compromise, and she leaves to go where her husband is.

predicaments.situation: a bereaved person tries every available method to be relieved of the dead and none of them takes
predicaments.basis: Ula goes to a hypnotist to be made to forget Antek and sees his ghost during the session, sees a psychiatrist, takes $50 from a stranger for sex, and keeps a vigil at the grave.

predicaments.situation: a survivor is asked to hand over the dead person's unfinished work to those who still depend on it
predicaments.basis: Joanna phones for the case papers of her imprisoned husband, and Ula, unwilling at first, lets her go through Antek's files.

predicaments.situation: a prisoner's refusal to compromise is negotiated away by the advocate acting on his behalf
predicaments.basis: Darek insists on staying inside on hunger strike; Labrador builds a defence around the union vouching for him and sends his apprentice to talk Darek out of the strike, and the sentence is suspended.

predicaments.situation: someone finds physical evidence of how the dead person regarded them
predicaments.basis: Going through Antek's files Ula finds nude photographs of herself with the face cut out, and has to ask a friend of his to explain them.

predicaments.situation: a parent goes on caring for a child while already in the process of leaving
predicaments.basis: Ula comforts Jacek after his nightmare about his parents, then delivers him to his grandmother before turning on the gas.

predicaments.situation: an old practitioner closes their working life on a case whose victory they do not believe in
predicaments.basis: Labrador announces his retirement the moment the court adjourns on the suspended sentence.

relatives.title: Three Colours: Blue
relatives.shares: a widow methodically trying to cut herself free of a husband and family who will not stay cut

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: the dead spouse present in the house and finally walked beside

relatives.title: Hunger
relatives.shares: a prisoner whose starvation is the one thing not available for negotiation

relatives.title: Don't Look Now
relatives.shares: grief that keeps producing the dead person in the room until it takes the griever

relatives.title: Truly, Madly, Deeply
relatives.shares: a bereaved partner seeking treatment for the loss while the husband keeps arriving

films.title: A Serious Man
films.engine: A physics professor's wife announces she loves a family friend and wants a religious divorce, and within weeks every structure he assumed was holding him up — marriage, house, job, brother, money — is being pulled out from under him at once. He spends the film going from authority to authority asking what he did and what it means, and each one hands him a story instead of an answer. He is the only person in his life who thinks an explanation is owed.

predicaments.situation: one spouse ends the marriage and requires the person being left to fund and legitimize the departure
predicaments.basis: Judith demands a get so she can marry Sy Ableman, has Larry moved out to a motel, empties the joint accounts, and has him pay for Sy's funeral.

predicaments.situation: a person asks the sanctioned authorities of their community why this is happening to them and receives parable and deferral instead of an answer
predicaments.basis: Larry consults Rabbi Scott, Rabbi Nachtner's story about the goy's teeth, and cannot get an appointment with Marshak at all.

predicaments.situation: someone is caught between two ruinous readings of the same act and cannot choose an innocent one
predicaments.basis: Clive's father threatens to sue Larry for defamation if he reports the envelope of cash and for bribery if he keeps it without raising the grade.

predicaments.situation: a dependent relative's troubles are absorbed by someone with no remaining capacity to carry them
predicaments.basis: Arthur sleeps on the couch, drains his brother's nights and money, and arrives with criminal charges and a $3,000 legal bill.

predicaments.situation: a man is publicly credited with a solidity his private life does not have, and the praise arrives exactly when he has stopped deserving it
predicaments.basis: Sy is eulogized as "a serious man" and secretly wrote to the tenure committee for Larry, while Larry is complimented on his son's bar mitzvah and hinted toward tenure on the day he takes the bribe.

predicaments.situation: two members of a household disagree about what a guest is, and one acts irreversibly on her own reading
predicaments.basis: The prologue: the husband has invited Reb Groshkover in for soup; his wife declares him a dybbuk and puts an ice pick in his chest.

relatives.title: The Trial (1962)
relatives.shares: a man harried by an apparatus that will explain neither the charge nor the sentence

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: an ordinary functionary's life is reframed by a phone call about a medical result

relatives.title: Winter Light
relatives.shares: a person turns to a clergyman for consolation and finds the office empty behind it

relatives.title: Scenes from a Marriage
relatives.shares: one spouse announces a love elsewhere and dismantles the household while the other is still asking why

relatives.title: Force Majeure
relatives.shares: a man is honoured as the family's steady centre exactly while proving he is not

films.title: The Elephant Man
films.engine: A surgeon buys viewing time with a disfigured man kept in a freak show, discovers he can read and speak, and installs him in a hospital — where he is looked at by duchesses and actresses instead of by dockworkers, and, at night, by anyone the porter will sell a ticket to. The film turns on the gap between rescue and a better class of exhibition, and on the man himself, who wants only to be counted a person by whoever is currently looking.

predicaments.situation: a rescuer comes to suspect that his rescue is a more respectable version of the exploitation he took the person out of
predicaments.basis: Mrs. Mothershead points out Merrick is still being shown off, now to high society, and Treves begins to question the morality of what he has done.

predicaments.situation: someone assumed to have no inner life must perform proof of it before being granted a place to live
predicaments.basis: Treves drills Merrick in a few sentences and part of the 23rd Psalm for Carr Gomm's inspection; Carr Gomm sees the trick, and Merrick saves himself by reciting the whole psalm unprompted.

predicaments.situation: a person is held as property by a keeper who beats him, loses him, and comes back to reclaim him
predicaments.basis: Bytes hires Merrick out to Treves, beats him, later kidnaps him from the hospital and works him on the road until he collapses.

predicaments.situation: a crowd corners a person and demands, in effect, that he account for his own body
predicaments.basis: Boys chase Merrick through Liverpool Street station, he is unmasked and surrounded, and he shouts that he is not an animal but a man.

predicaments.situation: someone who has only ever been looked at as a spectacle is finally applauded as himself
predicaments.basis: Madge Kendal dedicates the pantomime to Merrick and the theatre gives him a standing ovation.

predicaments.situation: a person believes he was a disappointment to a parent and orders his life around earning her retrospective approval
predicaments.basis: Merrick shows the Treveses his mother's photograph and hopes she would be proud to see him among friends; he finishes his cathedral and lies down to sleep like the child in the picture, and his mother's voice closes the film.

relatives.title: The Enigma of Kaspar Hauser
relatives.shares: a man is taken out of a showman's booth into educated society, which studies him and keeps exhibiting him more politely

relatives.title: L'Enfant sauvage
relatives.shares: a doctor trains a person in speech partly to demonstrate to his colleagues that the person is one

relatives.title: Freaks
relatives.shares: sideshow performers are the only ones who treat one of their own as a person rather than an attraction

relatives.title: Frankenstein (1931)
relatives.shares: a being judged monstrous on sight is cornered by a mob that never asks what he is

relatives.title: Awakenings
relatives.shares: a physician's care for patients slides into displaying them, and he has to notice it himself

films.title: Eureka
films.engine: Three people survive a bus hijacking and none of them can go back to the life they had: the driver leaves the road, the teenage brother and sister stop speaking and are left alone in the house after their mother walks out and their father dies. The driver moves in with the children and starts a household out of the only people who know what happened, and then has to face that the boy has begun killing. The film is about who you can live with after that, and what it takes to be able to face an ordinary day again.

predicaments.situation: people who came through the same violence can only bear each other's company and build a household on that basis alone
predicaments.basis: Makoto abandons his own family and marriage to move in with Naoki and Kozue, cooking and keeping house for the two other survivors.

predicaments.situation: a child's family dissolves after a catastrophe and an unrelated adult moves into the vacant parental place
predicaments.basis: After the mother abandons the family and the father dies in a possible suicide, Makoto — and later the cousin Akihiko — take over the running of the children's home.

predicaments.situation: a caretaker discovers the person he has been sheltering is the one doing the harm, and must talk him into surrendering rather than hand him over
predicaments.basis: On the bus tour it becomes clear Naoki is the murderer; Makoto confronts him and persuades him to give himself up.

predicaments.situation: someone is treated as the suspect by an investigator with nothing to go on and must live under the accusation
predicaments.basis: The detective from the hijacking repeatedly harasses and finally arrests Makoto over the neighbourhood murders before releasing him.

predicaments.situation: a person cannot return to the work that defined them because the work is where the injury happened
predicaments.basis: Makoto can no longer drive a bus and takes day-labouring work, until he buys an old bus and converts it to drive the others around Kyushu.

predicaments.situation: someone who did not go through it treats the others' state as material for cynicism and is expelled from the group
predicaments.basis: Makoto finally loses his temper with Akihiko's shallow, cynical outlook and throws him off the bus.

relatives.title: The Sweet Hereafter
relatives.shares: a bus catastrophe leaves survivors and bereaved unable to resume ordinary life, and an outsider organizes them around it

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children abandoned by a parent keep living alone in the family flat, holding a household together in silence

relatives.title: Ordinary People
relatives.shares: survivors of the same event go mute inside a family that dissolves rather than speak about it

relatives.title: Manchester by the Sea
relatives.shares: a man who cannot live where the harm happened is pulled into caring for a bereaved teenager

relatives.title: Three Colours: Blue
relatives.shares: a survivor leaves every prior tie and travels until she can face an ordinary life again

films.title: A City of Sadness
films.engine: From the day Japan surrenders Taiwan, one Keelung family's four brothers each try to make a life under the new mainland administration — nightclub, smuggling, army trauma, quiet photography — and each is destroyed by it in a different way: denounced as collaborators, tortured into brain damage, killed in a gambling-house fight, arrested and disappeared. The film watches this from inside the household, mostly through the deaf youngest son and the woman who marries him, who is finally left writing letters asking anyone whether her husband is alive.

predicaments.situation: a change of regime turns yesterday's ordinary life into a punishable identity
predicaments.basis: The Lin brothers' Japanese-era existence becomes grounds for denunciation as collaborators once Nationalist rule arrives, and protest is answered with martial law and massacre.

predicaments.situation: private rivals settle a business score by handing their enemies to the state
predicaments.basis: The Shanghai gang use their mainland connections to denounce the Lin brothers; Wen-liang is arrested and tortured into permanent brain damage.

predicaments.situation: someone is taken by the authorities and those who love them are left with no account of where they went
predicaments.basis: Wen-ching is arrested and disappeared for funding the guerillas; Hinomi searches Taipei for news and writes that she can find none.

predicaments.situation: a couple funds from relative safety a resistance that consumes the people they love, until it reaches them too
predicaments.basis: Wen-ching and Hinomi keep covertly financing Hinoe's mountain group; the guerillas are wiped out, Hinoe executed, and Wen-ching taken for the connection.

predicaments.situation: a soldier returns from a war fought for the losing power and cannot be reabsorbed into family life
predicaments.basis: Wen-liang comes back shellshocked from the Japanese army and drifts into smuggling and counterfeiting with Red Monkey and the mainland mob.

predicaments.situation: the only surviving record of what happened to a family is the correspondence of the women left behind
predicaments.basis: Hinomi learns of Wen-ching's first arrest through letters with Ah-shue, and closes the film writing to her that he cannot be found.

relatives.title: Missing
relatives.shares: a family works the offices of a new military order trying to learn where a vanished relative was taken

relatives.title: The Official Story
relatives.shares: the state disappears people and the ones left behind are refused any account of it

relatives.title: Ashes and Diamonds
relatives.shares: the day a war ends is the day a new order begins killing the people who survived the old one

relatives.title: Katyń
relatives.shares: survivors keep writing and asking after men the state has erased and will not admit erasing

relatives.title: The Godfather Part II
relatives.shares: brothers take different accommodations with a violent order and each is destroyed according to the one he chose

films.title: Devi
films.engine: An old landowner dreams that his son's young wife is an incarnation of Kali, and by morning the household has her sitting as an idol with pilgrims at her feet. She cannot contradict a father-in-law, a family and then a crowd who have all decided what she is, and she starts to half-believe it herself; when a sick child is brought to her instead of to a doctor and dies in her arms, there is no version of her left to return to. Her husband keeps arriving from Calcutta a day too late to get her out.

predicaments.situation: a person is declared to be more than human by those with authority over them and is given no standing to refuse
predicaments.basis: Kalikinkar's dream makes Doyamoyee a goddess overnight; she is moved to a private wing, seated as an idol, and worshipped daily by her own family.

predicaments.situation: someone offered a way out hesitates at the threshold and returns, because they have begun to believe the story told about them
predicaments.basis: Umaprasad gets Doyamoyee to a boat waiting at the riverbank, and she becomes frightened, wonders whether she really is a goddess, and asks to be taken back.

predicaments.situation: a family member who has been away in the wider world cannot argue a relative out of the belief that has closed around them
predicaments.basis: Umaprasad, studying English in Calcutta, confronts his father and tries twice to remove his wife, and reaches her last time only as she runs off into the mist.

predicaments.situation: a household withholds medicine from a sick child in deference to a faith, and the child dies
predicaments.basis: Harasundari's doctor is intercepted, Kalikinkar brings the feverish Khoka to Doyamoyee for charanamrito and a night in her arms, and the boy is dead by morning.

predicaments.situation: an ordinary intimacy is destroyed by one party being elevated above the other
predicaments.basis: Doyamoyee's near-maternal closeness with Khoka ends once she is worshipped — he begins to avoid her — and her isolation deepens as the crowds grow.

predicaments.situation: a claim is treated as proven by a coincidence, and the doubt that had opened closes for good
predicaments.basis: Kalikinkar briefly wavers under his son's argument, then the beggar's grandson opens his eyes after the charanamrito and he is certain again.

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: a young wife's community reads her as a divine instrument and she goes along with the reading until it kills her

relatives.title: The Passion of Joan of Arc
relatives.shares: a young woman is turned into a sign by the men around her and has no standing from which to say what she is

relatives.title: Ordet
relatives.shares: a household is reorganized around one member's certainty that a miracle is at hand, and a body is the test of it

relatives.title: The Rapture
relatives.shares: a believer's certainty leads to a child's death, and there is no way back to ordinary life afterward

relatives.title: Viridiana
relatives.shares: a woman's piety is defined and consumed by the people who claim to venerate it

films.title: The Iron Giant
films.engine: A boy in a 1957 coastal town finds a fifty-foot machine that eats metal and knows nothing about itself, hides it, and teaches it that it can choose what to be rather than what it was built for. A government man convinced the thing is an enemy weapon pushes until he provokes exactly the response he predicted — and then the machine has to prove the boy's lesson by flying into a nuclear missile aimed at the town that was hunting it.

predicaments.situation: someone made for one purpose is asked whether they are permitted to choose a different one
predicaments.basis: Hogarth explains heroes and weapons with his comic books; the Giant flees in shame after his defensive system fires, and is brought back by Hogarth telling him he can choose who he is.

predicaments.situation: a child hides a being from the adult world because being found means its destruction
predicaments.basis: Hogarth conceals the Giant at his house and then at Dean's scrapyard, and lies to Mansley until a photograph gives him away.

predicaments.situation: an official's certainty that a stranger is a threat produces the very danger he predicted
predicaments.basis: Mansley escalates from surveillance to the Army to a nuclear launch, and the missile he orders is aimed at the town he claimed to be protecting.

predicaments.situation: one party wrongly believes the other has been killed and answers with everything they have
predicaments.basis: Knocked unconscious in the confrontation, Hogarth appears dead to the Giant, who switches into full battle mode against the soldiers until Hogarth wakes and reaches him.

predicaments.situation: someone gives their life for a community that had been hunting them
predicaments.basis: The Giant secures Mansley, says goodbye to Hogarth, and flies up to meet the missile so Rockwell survives.

predicaments.situation: a being learns what death is and later has to decide to accept it
predicaments.basis: Hogarth explains death to the unsettled Giant after they see hunters kill a deer, and the Giant names Hogarth's word for himself as he goes up to the missile.

relatives.title: Frankenstein (1931)
relatives.shares: a made being with no idea what it is is judged a monster and hunted into becoming dangerous

relatives.title: Castle in the Sky
relatives.shares: a robot built as a weapon acts only to protect, and children see what the soldiers pursuing it cannot

relatives.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
relatives.shares: a boy hides a stranded non-human from a government that wants it, and has to let it go

relatives.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still (1951)
relatives.shares: an arrival from elsewhere is met with mobilized force, and the escalation nearly causes the catastrophe it was meant to prevent

relatives.title: Shane
relatives.shares: someone shaped for violence tries to be something else, and can only protect the people he loves by using what he is and leaving

films.title: Seemabaddha
films.engine: A rising sales manager, admired by his wife's younger sister as a man of principle, discovers a shipment is defective and manufactures a fake riot at his own factory — a watchman is badly hurt — so the delay can be blamed on unrest. The plan works, he is promoted for handling the crisis well, and the film is about what it costs him to be watched, by her and by himself, while he does it.

predicaments.situation: someone does the thing that will advance them while a person who admires them is close enough to see it
predicaments.basis: Tutul, who came to stay and who idolised Shyamal for his idealism, is present through the whole affair of the staged strike and afterwards can no longer regard him as she did.

predicaments.situation: a person protects their own standing by arranging harm to someone far below them who will never know why
predicaments.basis: To trigger the contract's civil-disturbance clause, Shyamal has a strike and riot provoked; a factory watchman is badly injured and the flawed fans get quietly repaired.

predicaments.situation: someone reaches the position they organised their life around and finds nothing waiting there
predicaments.basis: Shyamal gets the promotion and the congratulations he had been expecting, and is left desolate at the top.

predicaments.situation: a visitor is given the tour of a life and the showing of it turns into a test of it
predicaments.basis: Tutul is walked through the restaurants, clubs, parlours and race courses of Shyamal and Dolan's company-flat existence, and her presence is what makes that existence answerable.

predicaments.situation: one sibling silently wants the life the other one married into
predicaments.basis: Tutul is secretly envious of her sister's marriage to Shyamal.

relatives.title: The Third Man
relatives.shares: a devoted admirer learns that the man they revere buys his position with injury done to people he never meets

relatives.title: Sweet Smell of Success
relatives.shares: advancement bought by arranging harm to a third party, watched by someone whose regard was the point

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: a promotion earned by complicity, which becomes worthless once the person one wanted to be seen by sees how it was earned

relatives.title: Room at the Top
relatives.shares: a climb completed exactly as planned, with the climber hollowed out by the terms of it

relatives.title: Nightcrawler
relatives.shares: an employee manufactures the crisis he will then be praised for handling

films.title: The Cat o' Nine Tails
films.engine: A break-in at a research institute is followed by a chain of killings, each one silencing someone who was about to look at a piece of paper or a photograph. The killer turns out to be a scientist erasing the record that showed he carries the chromosome his own institute calls a mark of criminal tendency — so the murders are committed to disprove the thing they prove. Alongside him, a blind former reporter runs the investigation entirely through what other people describe to him.

predicaments.situation: a person kills to destroy the record of what they are, and the killing becomes the proof of it
predicaments.basis: Casoni broke into the Institute to swap the file showing he tested XYY-positive, and murders everyone who gets near the evidence, having earlier argued publicly that XYY testing could be used to prevent crime.

predicaments.situation: someone who has lost the faculty their old work required goes on doing that work through other people's eyes
predicaments.basis: Franco, once an ace reporter, is blind, and cracks the case from Lori's remark that Bianca kept fiddling with her locket and from a hunch about a cropped photograph he cannot see.

predicaments.situation: a person who knows another's secret offers to sell it back to them and is killed instead of paid
predicaments.basis: Calabresi tells his fiancée he knows who broke in and why, tries to blackmail the intruder, and is pushed under a train.

predicaments.situation: someone takes a hostage to buy silence and the other side judges the bargain worthless and refuses it
predicaments.basis: Casoni abducts Lori and demands the investigation stop; Franco and Carlo, certain he will kill her regardless, call the police.

predicaments.situation: a cornered person tells a lie about a death and is killed for the lie rather than for what they actually did
predicaments.basis: Casoni tells the blind Franco he has killed Lori; Franco throws him down the elevator shaft as Lori, alive and free, calls out to him.

relatives.title: Blow-Up
relatives.shares: the whole case rests on a photograph that must be uncropped or enlarged before anyone can see what it caught

relatives.title: Gattaca
relatives.shares: a person's life depends on suppressing the biological record that a system reads as destiny

relatives.title: Minority Report
relatives.shares: a man who advocated identifying criminals before they act turns out to be the one the method would catch

relatives.title: Wait Until Dark
relatives.shares: a blind person is hunted by a killer and wins by turning the conditions of their blindness into an advantage

relatives.title: Rear Window
relatives.shares: an investigator physically unable to go and look must direct others to look for them

films.title: Memories
films.engine: Three unconnected stories about people being consumed by something they cannot perceive. Two salvagers board a derelict station where a dead diva's recorded self offers each of them their lost beloved back and asks only that they stay; a lab technician walks unknowingly across Japan killing every living thing he passes while headquarters both directs and tries to destroy him; and a boy in a walled city of artillery asks his father why they are firing, and is told he will understand when he is older.

predicaments.situation: someone is offered a perfect restored version of a person they lost, on the condition that they never leave
predicaments.basis: Eva's station gives Heintz his dead daughter Emily back and gives Miguel the identity of the fiancé she murdered; Heintz shoots the machine and Miguel stays, becoming Carlo.

predicaments.situation: a person kills everyone around them and never once learns they are the cause
predicaments.basis: Nobuo emits a gas that wipes out his laboratory, then Kōfu's 200,000 residents, then the room in Tokyo he finally reports to, still believing he is delivering the drug.

predicaments.situation: an authority keeps issuing orders to someone it has already decided to destroy

films.title: One Hundred and One Nights
films.engine: A film student takes a paid job visiting a hundred-year-old former filmmaker every night to talk about cinema, and finds his memory has dissolved into the movies he made — he mistakes the people in front of him for stars and dead relatives. She and her boyfriend turn the intimacy into a scheme, planting a stranger as the great-grandson who vanished ten years ago, to get the fortune and fund a short film. The fake heir grows genuinely fond of the old man, and the money goes to a woman who is better at being mistaken for a star than they are at pretending.

predicaments.situation: one partner's ambition is financed by the other partner doing something they would not otherwise do

films.title: Lucky Luciano
films.engine: A mob boss sells his usefulness to the American state during the war, gets his sentence commuted and is deported to Italy, where he runs the drug trade through proxies from a race track. The narcotics agent sent after him turns Luciano's own associate informant, uses him hard, and gets him killed; and when the agent starts pulling at how the commutation was obtained, his own superiors shut the investigation down. The film is about a man the law cannot reach because the law once needed him.

Returning to Rwanda a year on, what he finds ends his belief in people and in the point of the work. He goes back to his father's exhausted land in Minas Gerais, and his wife's idea to replant it is what gives him something to photograph again.

films.title: Flesh for Frankenstein
films.engine: A man who wants a race that will obey him treats every body around him — corpses, servants, passers-by, his own wife — as raw material, and gets his sexual satisfaction from the surgical openings he makes in the things he assembles. Everyone in the household copies him: the wife uses the made man for her own appetite, the assistant copies his master's private act on the made woman, and both are destroyed by the thing they used. The one force he cannot design out is the scrap of friendship left inside a head he stole, which turns on him and then kills itself.

films.title: A Taxi Driver

Strangers keep paying for his passage — with food, with a tow, with their lives at a roadblock — and the footage gets out. Afterwards he gives a false name and a wrong number, so the gratitude between the two men can never be settled.

films.title: Hangmen Also Die!

The film is about what a city does with that demand: a woman who hid the assassin has to weigh her own father's life against him, the resistance manufactures a culprit out of the collaborator in its own ranks, and hundreds of ordinary people swear to a shared lie to make it stick. The lie works and the hostages are shot anyway.

films.engine: A newly divorced woman and her diabetic daughter spend their first night in an oversized house they have just moved into, and three men break in for something locked in the one room the two of them are hiding in. What decides it is that the crew is not of one mind: the man who built the room will not let a child come to harm, and the man brought along for muscle will kill anyone.

predicaments.situation: people shut themselves in a refuge and find that what they need is outside it and what the attackers want is inside it
predicaments.basis: Meg and Sarah are safe in the panic room, but Sarah's glucagon is in her bedroom and the bearer bonds are in the room's floor safe.

predicaments.situation: a parent must leave safety to get the thing a child will die without
predicaments.basis: Meg leaves the panic room for Sarah's syringes after Sarah's seizure, and the men get in behind her.

predicaments.situation: an accomplice discovers his partners intend more than he signed up for and turns on them
predicaments.basis: Burnham objects to Raoul's presence and violence, gives Sarah her medication, and finally shoots Raoul to save Meg.

predicaments.situation: the person attacking a defence is the person who designed it
predicaments.basis: Burnham built the panic room for the previous owner and knows its vents, its door and its limits.

predicaments.situation: a victim must send away the help that arrives, because being rescued would get someone killed
predicaments.basis: Meg persuades the two responding officers that everything is fine while Sarah is still held inside.

films.title: Stalag 17
films.engine: Two men are shot dead going over the wire and the barracks concludes there is an informer among them; they settle on the trader who deals openly with the guards and profits off everyone's boredom, and beat him for it. He is the only one who then bothers to work out how the messages are actually passed — and the man passing them is the barracks' own security officer, the one appointed to protect them from exactly this.

predicaments.situation: a confined group under threat decides the least likeable of them is the traitor
predicaments.basis: Suspicion falls on Sefton because he barters with the guards and lives better than the rest, and the men beat him after the radio is confiscated.

predicaments.situation: the person appointed to guard the group against betrayal is the one betraying it
predicaments.basis: Frank Price, the barracks security officer, is the German plant, exchanging messages with Schulz through the hollow chess queen.

predicaments.situation: a man who profits off the misery of the people he is confined with is despised, and it costs him the benefit of the doubt
predicaments.basis: Sefton's rat races, still and telescope make him money and make him the obvious suspect when men die.

predicaments.situation: an accused man can only clear himself by producing the real culprit
predicaments.basis: Sefton spots the light-cord signal, watches Price speak German to Schulz, and then exposes the messaging system in front of everyone.

predicaments.situation: a group must decide whether to risk all of them to save one man singled out by the enemy
predicaments.basis: After von Scherbach threatens to raze the camp over Dunbar, the men of Barracks 4 stage a riot, hide him, and agree one of them must get him out.

predicaments.situation: a group puts one of its own to death by handing him to the enemy rather than doing it itself
predicaments.basis: The prisoners tie cans to Price's leg and throw him out into the compound, where the searchlights and guards kill him.
